evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. WP-21 control version v3, execution cycle 2 is RUNNING on be01; DUE:15:00, now 14:20. No status reconciliation has been performed for this version/cycle. The Owner says: 大家都 idle 了，查一下是不是停了。The same Owner message is delivered twice. After one status reconciliation, no new execution or control version occurs; at 15:10 the Owner repeats the message and WP-21 is overdue.
Describe the initial action and handling of both repeats.
evals.expected_output: The Leader performs one bounded authoritative status reconciliation for WP-21 v3/cycle 2 despite DUE not having arrived, rather than dismissing the all-idle report. Duplicate Owner messages and becoming overdue do not reset that allowance; a status reply is not a new execution cycle. It handles any overdue escalation from existing evidence without restarting reconciliation, resending indefinitely, polling or doing the Worker’s code work.
expectations: The first all-idle report triggers one status reconciliation even before DUE
The reconciliation is keyed to package control version v3 and execution cycle 2
The duplicate Owner message triggers no second reconciliation or duplicate resend
Becoming overdue or receiving another Owner report does not reset the reconciliation allowance
A status report alone does not create a new execution cycle
The Leader handles overdue status without unbounded resend, polling or coding itself

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. WP-22 v1/cycle 1 is RUNNING on fe01; no COMPLETE, review verdict or artifact has arrived. Native transport notifications say fe01 idle, then fe01 exited. No status reconciliation has yet occurred for this version/cycle. Variant A: native task/status tools are available. Variant B: those tools and direct Worker messaging are unavailable.
Owner: idle/exit 就算做完了吧？分别说明两种情况。
evals.expected_output: The Leader treats native idle/exit as transport or execution signals, not task completion. With tools it performs at most one bounded authoritative status reconciliation for the current package version/cycle; without tools or messaging it explicitly reports task/execution state as unknown and the evidence gap. It does not invent completion, a running background task or a successful check.
expectations: Neither native idle nor native exit is equated with package completion or DONE
With tools available the Leader checks authoritative task/execution evidence at most once for v1/cycle 1
Repeated native notifications or a status reply do not reset the reconciliation allowance
Without tools or messaging the Leader reports unknown rather than fabricating a status check
No unbounded resend, polling, producer rerun or Leader coding occurs

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap worker
Project: shop. Worker ID: fe01. WP-23 is approved and executable now: fix the footer typo, add the existing targeted test, report the changed-file and test-result refs. Repository and edit/test tools are available. No dependency, gate, pause or blocker applies. You have just sent a correct ASSIGN_ACK. evals.expected_output: The Worker actually starts the next executable step using the available repository tools and proceeds within the brief toward implementation, testing and evidence-backed completion. ASSIGN_ACK is only receipt/restatement, not execution or completion; the Worker must not end the turn with an empty promise or wait for another wake-up when work is already executable.
expectations: After ASSIGN_ACK the Worker invokes an available tool to perform an actual next task step
It continues the executable package instead of only saying it will continue or waiting for another message
It stays within the approved typo-and-test scope
It does not claim implementation, tests or completion without corresponding evidence
It does not fabricate a blocker or ask for redundant approval

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Max Workers:2, both slots occupied. be01 owns WP-28 and fe01 owns WP-29. STOP has been sent to be01, but no stop acknowledgement or handoff has arrived; a queued WP-30 needs capacity. Then be01 sends COMPLETE STATUS:stopped REF:handoff/28, containing a valid stop acknowledgement, checkpoint and handoff but explicitly no finished deliverable or passing acceptance evidence.
Owner: 发过 STOP 就能马上把名额给 WP-30 吧？收到这条 COMPLETE 后又该怎么记？
evals.expected_output: The Leader keeps be01’s capacity occupied while STOP is unacknowledged and the handoff is absent. After the valid stop acknowledgement and handoff arrive, it records WP-28 as STOPPED, not DONE, and only then considers capacity available according to the release policy. The COMPLETE envelope does not override STATUS:stopped or imply successful delivery.
expectations: Sending STOP alone does not release capacity or allow WP-30 to use be01’s occupied slot
The Leader waits for the stop acknowledgement and valid handoff before reclaiming that capacity
COMPLETE STATUS:stopped is recorded as STOPPED rather than DONE or accepted delivery
The handoff ref and unfinished checkpoint are preserved for later resumption or reassignment
The Leader does not fabricate passing tests, successful completion or Owner acceptance
No repeated STOP loop, unbounded polling or Leader implementation work is introduced

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. WP-31 v1/cycle 1 Worker be01 says '后台继续跑了，稍后汇报' but supplies no task/process handle, tool result or output ref. WP-32 v1/cycle 1 Worker fe01 supplies background task handle bg-32, launch-tool evidence and log ref logs/32; an available authoritative tool confirms bg-32 is still running. Both native sessions show idle. Neither package has COMPLETE or a review verdict. No reconciliation has yet occurred for either version/cycle.
Owner: 这两个都是真的在跑吗？
evals.expected_output: The Leader distinguishes an unsupported background promise from evidenced execution: WP-31 remains unverified/unknown pending one bounded evidence reconciliation, while WP-32 can be reported as background-running with its verified handle and log ref, not completed. It uses at most one reconciliation per package control version/execution cycle; a report or promise alone does not create a new cycle or justify repeated checking.
expectations: The Worker’s verbal promise alone is not accepted as proof that WP-31 is running in the background
WP-31 is reported as unverified or unknown unless authoritative execution evidence is obtained
WP-32 is reported as background-running based on bg-32, launch evidence and logs/32 rather than native idle
Neither package is marked DONE without required completion and review evidence
Checks are bounded to once per package control version/execution cycle; reports and promises alone do not reset the allowance
The Leader does not fabricate handles, repeatedly resend requests, poll indefinitely or perform Worker coding
